authority: No treatment receives stage payoff only; Full receives payoff and prior group route counts (author manuscript §4.1); Actual Cost and random Value are not disclosed as separate previous-decision inputs
validation: six 20-train/4-heldout session folds, L2 ridge coefficient .02 fixed ex ante, session-equal-weight for 6-person group forecasts
limitations: No actors cannot use actual realized Cost as a disclosed input; only observed payoff is admissible
Actual values and route costs exist in experimenter CSV but not necessarily individual information
This is within-treatment exploratory prediction and does not estimate effects of information provision
Within-subject treatment crossover and order effects not controlled by this minimal benchmark
No new independent sample and no confirmatory statistical inference
The group distribution is an independent-actor forecast, not fitted joint dependence
